description: This file defines a React component 'DraftPersonaClient' for displaying and managing a draft persona within a career navigation app. It includes functions for fetching draft data from backend or local storage, parsing and coercing JSON data, and rendering the UI with persona details, career highlights, and raw JSON view.

methods.name: safeJsonParse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string safely, returning null on error.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out falsy or invalid entries.

methods.name: coerceCareerHighlights
methods.description: Transforms various input formats into an array of CareerHighlightItem objects.

methods.name: fetchLatestPersistedDraft
methods.description: Fetches the latest draft persistently stored for a given personaId via API call.
